names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 ianuarie, «Sfântul Meletie Mărturisitorul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Μελέτιος ο Γαλησιώτης ο Ομολογητής», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life: «De obârșie din ținutul Mării Negre (în jurul anului 1209) și fiu al unui general celebru» — around 1209, the page says, and no closer.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Când și-a dat în cele din urmă duhul Domnului, chipul său strălucea mai mult decât soarele (1286).»

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 19 ianuarie — «Sfântul Meletie Mărturisitorul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Ιανουαρίου — «Όσιος Μελέτιος ο Γαλησιώτης ο Ομολογητής»

attestations.note: saint.gr gives his years as 1206 and 1283 at the age of seventy-seven — «γεννήθηκε το έτος 1206 μ.Χ.» and «κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το 1283 μ.Χ. σε ηλικία 77 ετών» (https://www.saint.gr/1136/saint.aspx) — where doxologia.ro, cited on this folder's Romanian row, gives about 1209 and 1286. The readings are left standing side by side and the folder's dates are not changed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
